title: Let's start with what this system is
intro: Eight questions, a few minutes. Answer the way you would explain it to a new engineer on day one — your words, not the framework's.

questions.label: What does this system do, in one or two sentences?
questions.placeholder: It takes… and turns it into… for…

questions.label: Who uses it — and what do you call them?
questions.help: The words matter: users, members, tenants, accounts, operators, customers…

questions.label: Name the three to five things the system is really about.
questions.help: The nouns that show up in every conversation: an order, a run, a workspace, a harness…

questions.label: Which word causes the most arguments or confusion on the team?
questions.help: The one that means two things depending on who says it.

questions.label: Whose words do you speak at the edges?
questions.help: Frameworks and platforms whose vocabulary leaks into yours.

questions.label: Any words you have decided NOT to use — and what to say instead?
Is there a design system or token set the UI is supposed to follow?
How strict should the vocabulary gate be?
